name: Muha Meds x Cookies | 2g Disposable | Cereal Milk
description: Indulge in the smooth, nostalgic flavor of Cereal Milk — a perfectly balanced hybrid that’s as comforting as a bowl of your favorite morning treat. Sweet, creamy, and slightly fruity, this strain delivers a euphoric lift that mellows into pure satisfaction. Every puff swirls together sugary goodness and silky smoothness for a flavor that’s both playful and soothing.
